mesoscaleDiscussions.areas: Southwestern Lower Michigan into far northern Indiana
mesoscaleDiscussions.summary: Risk for damaging winds will increase in northern Indiana and southern Lower Michigan as a bowing segment moves south-southeast into the afternoon. A watch is possible for portions of these areas.

details.label: Areas affected
details.text: Southwestern Lower Michigan into far northern Indiana

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Dewpoints continue to increase ahead of a small bowing cluster currently near Milwaukee. By the time this cluster crosses southern Lake Michigan, temperatures in southeastern Lower Michigan/far northern Indiana will be in the 80s F. Sufficient shear and modest lift from a convectively enhanced perturbation should allow this activity to move along the lifting theta-e gradient. Some risk for damaging winds will likely accompany this bowing segment into the afternoon. A watch is possible for portions of Lower Michigan and northern Indiana.
